result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: a stuck loading spinner overlaying the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image.

issues.description: A white circular loading spinner overlay with a green progress arc is stuck in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar cover image in the 'Popular right now' section, obscuring the food photo even though the image underneath appears loaded
issues.suggestion: Hide/dismiss the loading indicator once the image finishes loading so the full cover image is visible without obstruction
